summary: Namco's Dig Dug-adjacent action-puzzle series about drilling through colored blocks, spanning arcades, handhelds, Japanese mobile releases, Wii/DSi/Xbox download games, and the modern DrillLand remaster.

entries.title: Mr. Driller
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 5 digital release for current official play

emulation.emulator: Native PS5; DuckStation/Flycast/MAME for historical versions
emulation.notes: Use current PlayStation release for the main archive route; emulate older ports only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current digital console output; arcade/legacy ports vary.

primary.why: The original Mr. Driller has many legacy ports, but the PS4/PS5 digital release is the most current official route for capture while preserving the first game's core content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS5 digital release, or use the PlayStation/Dreamcast/arcade versions only for historical comparison and port-specific feel.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy ports differ in display, controls, and platform quirks, but no separate definitive remaster is documented for the first game.

entries.title: Mr. Driller 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release for capture; Nintendo Switch Online for current official GBA access

emulation.notes: Use mGBA or Nintendo Switch Online if the PC release is impractical.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Legacy PC or cleanly scaled GBA output.

primary.why: Mr. Driller 2 was released for arcade, GBA, and Windows; the PC release is the best capture route for the original sequel, while Nintendo Switch Online is the current official GBA-wrapper option.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC release if available for direct capture, or play the GBA version through Nintendo Switch Online or mGBA for the current official/portable route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo Switch Online is an emulated GBA-library release, not a remaster.

emulation.notes: Use internal resolution upscaling; fall back to MAME for arcade comparison.

primary.why: Mr. Driller G adds story and characters and was released for arcade and PlayStation in Japan; the PlayStation release gives the best home/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PlayStation release through DuckStation with internal resolution upscaling.

emulation.notes: Use integer scaling for clean GBA capture.

primary.why: Mr. Driller Ace / Mr. Driller A is documented as a Japan-only GBA release with pet/Pacteria mechanics, so the GBA version is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese GBA release in mGBA with integer scaling.

entries.title: Mr. Driller: Drill Land
entries.definitive_edition: Mr. DRILLER DrillLand HD remaster / Steam release

emulation.emulator: Native PC; Dolphin for GameCube original
emulation.notes: Use Steam for the main run.

primary.version: Mr. DRILLER DrillLand HD remaster / Steam release
primary.why: The HD remaster brings Drill Land to modern platforms with updated graphics, HD cutscenes, and the Western-localized release; PC is the cleanest capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mr. DRILLER DrillLand on Steam. Use the GameCube original only for the Japanese original-release experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remaster adds HD presentation and Casual Mode; use GameCube for original Japanese release comparison.
